name: Proactor AI
title: proactor.ai
shortDescription: Proactor AI is a proactive AI assistant designed to enhance productivity in various settings such as meetings, lectures, and calls. It listens actively, providing real-time advice, summaries, and action items without requiring manual input. Ideal for professionals and teams looking to streamline their workflow and make smarter decisions effortlessly. An example use case is during business meetings where Proactor AI can help capture key points and suggest actions on the fly.
